description: This file declares the MediaKeysIpc class and its factory, which are responsible for handling media key sessions via IPC in the Rialto client. It includes method declarations for creating, managing, and querying media key sessions, as well as handling IPC communication and events related to media keys.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating MediaKeysIpc instances, implementing IMediaKeysIpcFactory.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpc
classes.description: Implements IMediaKeys and IpcModule to manage media key sessions via IPC, including event handling and session management.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Creates a new MediaKeysIpc instance for a given key system.

methods.name: MediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MediaKeysIpc with key system, IPC client, and event thread factory.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Destructor for MediaKeysIpc.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in a session.

methods.name: createKeySession

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.description: Closes a key session.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: getDrmTime

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
